It can happen with or without cough and catarrh, so their absence does not rule out infection. Enlarged or inflamed tonsils (tonsillitis) can also cause throat pain and difficulty swallowing. For mild symptoms, use warm fluids, saltwater gargles, and paracetamol, and avoid smoke; seek testing if strep is suspected because antibiotics are only needed for bacterial causes.
